title: Qlik License Allocation Utilization
dataSources: Qlik Sense logs (`qlik:scheduler`, `qlik:engine`, `qlik:proxy`), QRS API task/audit (`qlik:qrs`), and Qlik Cloud events.
app: Qlik Sense logs via Universal Forwarder; Qlik Repository Service (QRS) API and Qlik Cloud REST API via HEC scripted inputs; QlikView/NPrinting event logs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:qrs object_type="license"
| stats latest(allocated) as allocated, latest(total) as total, latest(active_last_30d) as active by license_type
| eval used_pct=round(100*allocated/total,1), active_pct=round(100*active/allocated,1)
| sort - used_pct
description: Reports Qlik professional/analyzer license allocation versus total entitlement and how many allocated licenses were actually used in the last 30 days, exposing waste and headroom.
value: Qlik licenses are costly; showing allocated-but-idle seats reclaims spend and prevents surprise entitlement exhaustion.
implementation: Query QRS license objects; schedule weekly and flag idle allocations for reclamation and near-full pools for purchase.
visualization: Table of license type by utilisation, reclamation candidates.
grandmaExplanation: We track who has a Qlik licence and whether they use it so unused seats can be freed and money saved.
